sources.quote: In the beginning of 1974, Suntola and the small humidity sensor team moved from VTT to Instrumentarium (Ahertajantie 3, Tapiola, Espoo, Finland).
In 1983, the pilot production of TF-EL displays started in Lohja, the Kunnarla plant (Kaivurinkatu 5, Lohja, Finland).
In 1987, Tuomo Suntola was offered the chance to set up Microchemistry Ltd, as a subsidiary of Neste, for the development of ALE-based solar panels.

In 1999, Microchemistry with all its personnel, ALE expertise, and the patent portfolio was sold to the Dutch company ASM.
In 2004, Suntola joined Picosun Oy, first as the scientific adviser and, since 2007, as a board member.
